screens.variant: Page · Default / Form · On a Page
screens.expectation: Form hosted on a Page, Section, or Card template with stacked fields and footer actions.

patterns.variant: On a Page · Single-column fields + inline validation
patterns.expectation: Day of week, start/end time, session format (Online / In person), and optional 200-char note use PLUS form controls with inline field error messages on invalid save.

patterns.variant: Submit disabled until required fields filled
patterns.expectation: Save action is disabled until required fields are filled and explains or indicates why.
Valid save surfaces a confirmation Flag or Banner and clears the form.

against_placements.placement: Banner above or flush against PageHeader
against_placements.expectation: Counts against: placing Banner before PageHeader or flush against PageHeader.
